title: Persistent volume + schema design
principle: Files remain the source of truth for career-ops; volumes/DB are mounts and indexes — never invent a parallel SoT that drifts from cv.md / applications.md / reports/.

volume.service: shared by web + worker (same volume id)
volume.backup: Railway volume snapshots + optional rsync of /data to object storage later

migration_from_files: 2. rsync local CAREER_OPS_ROOT user-layer paths into volume (exclude node_modules, .git, web/.next)
4. Verify tracker row count + latest report readable
5. Optional later: Postgres mirror of applications.md for query — write-through still via merge-tracker.mjs
non_goals: Treating ephemeral container FS as SoT
Replacing markdown tracker with DB-only writes in POC
